title: Add schema-agnostic useForm hook (values, errors, touched, dirty, submit)
problem: Consumers wire Input/Select/Checkbox state by hand (value+error+touched per field); no shared validation lifecycle.
value: Removes the largest form boilerplate; works with any validator via a Resolver; typed field paths.
scope: API: useForm<T extends Record<string,unknown>>({defaultValues: T, resolver?: Resolver<T>, validateOn?: 'change'|'blur'|'submit' (default 'blur'), revalidateOn?: 'change'|'blur', onSubmit?: (values:T)=>void|Promise<void>}): { values, errors: Partial<Record<Path<T>,string>>, touched, dirty, isValid, isSubmitting, submitCount, setValue(path,v), setError(path,msg), reset(values?), validate(path?), handleSubmit(): ()=>Promise<void>, getFieldProps(path): {value, onChangeText, onBlur, error?: boolean, helperText?: string}, getCheckboxProps(path), getSwitchProps(path), getSelectProps(path) }. type Resolver<T> = (values:T)=>Errors<T>|Promise<Errors<T>>. Dot paths for nesting up to 3 levels.
Behavior: idle, validating, submitting, submitted; async validators with stale-result cancellation; submit with errors focuses first invalid registered ref.
Accessibility/platform notes: Does not render; exposes error strings so Field announces them; handleSubmit moves focus to first error field when refs registered via getFieldProps().ref.
Tests: validateOn modes; touched/dirty tracking; async resolver race (latest wins); nested paths; reset restores defaults; handleSubmit blocks on errors
